name: DisabilityStatusAssertion
title: Disability Status Assertion
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
description: This value set was developed to incorporate a newly available code that is more appropriately generic for documenting disability status. The original CUBS code remains most suitable when used specifically with the CUBS disability questions and answer sets
purpose: (Clinical Focus: This value set identifies questions used to capture whether a patient has a disability, supporting assessment and reporting of overall disability status.),(Data Element Scope: Includes LOINC codes that represent disability status as a question or assertion, where responses describe the presence or absence of disability.),(Inclusion Criteria: The LOINC codes as listed),(Exclusion Criteria: Codes that capture detailed disability characteristics, severity, or functional limitations)
